lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you want to do this weekend?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi, nǐ ne?
lines.en: I want to rest at home, and you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I want to go running in the park.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Tiānqì zěnme yàng? Huì hěn lěng ma?
lines.en: How's the weather? Will it be cold?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Bú huì, zhè jǐ tiān dōu hěn qíng.
lines.en: No, it's been sunny these days.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù ba.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒmen jǐ diǎn qù?
lines.en: Great, what time do we go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 可以，那我们公园门口见。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, nà wǒmen gōngyuán ménkǒu jiàn.
lines.en: Okay, let's meet at the park entrance.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Okay, call me when it is time.
